title: rewards.earned v1
description: Emitted after a successful earn on the rewards ledger. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-rewards-go, EventPublisher.PublishEarned (internal/service/events_publisher.go:225, event_type stamped at line 226). Renamed from rewards.points.earned 2026-07-03 (DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-rewards) to match the literal event_type string the producer emits. In production (real DB pool) this event is routed through OutboxEventPublisher.PublishEarned (internal/service/outbox_event_publisher.go:88, called from rewards.go:481) which relays via the alebrije-common-go outbox poller onto the enveloped events:rewards SSOT stream -- the shape this schema describes. NOTE: the pool-less fallback path (rewards.go:522, tests only) instead XADDs the Event struct FLAT (no envelope, no data-nesting) onto the bare rewards.earned stream via events_publisher.go -- that shape is out of scope for this schema and is not expected in prod traffic. Also drops the previously-required 'idempotency_key' data field: the real Event struct (events_publisher.go:205-218) has no such field -- it was never emitted, so every real rewards.earned event has always failed strict validation against the old schema; removing it is an additive/relaxing change per README.md section 6.

amount.description: Positive points awarded. Never zero, never negative.

reason.description: Why the points were granted (free text or enum key, e.g. purchase_earn). Optional on the wire (Go struct tag omitempty) even though every known 2026-07-03 call site (rewards.go earn path) always sets it.

account_id.description: Rewards account the points land on. Optional on the wire (Go struct tag omitempty) even though every known 2026-07-03 call site always sets it.

balance_after.description: Account balance after this transaction, for audit.

reference.description: Free-form reference to the originating entity (e.g. payment_id, visit_id).
